lines.en: label amisummer2nightgen:
scene amisummer2nightgen
I call Ami to find out that she’s just lounging around at home, so I decide to call it an early night and join her there.
lines.zh: 我打电话给 Ami，得知她正窝在家里无所事事，于是决定今晚早点收工，过去陪她。

lines.en: I’m {s}forced{/s} asked to stop at the convenience store for what she describes as “a disgusting amount of ice cream” but get confused once I arrive as there is no amount of ice cream that I would find disgusting.
lines.zh: 我{s}被迫{/s}答应在便利店停一下，买她口中的「多得恶心的冰淇淋」；可我一进店就困惑了——因为冰淇淋再多，我也不觉得有什么恶心的。

lines.en: As such, I pick up as much as I’m willing to carry and make it back home to a fresh plate of dinner that I devour almost instantaneously.
lines.zh: 于是我拎了些我扛得动的量回家，外加一盘刚做好的晚饭，我几乎是一口气吞了下去。

lines.en: Dinner is succeeded by a trip to Ami’s bedroom where the two of us sit on her couch as she shows me what {i}I{/i} would describe as “a disgusting amount of cat videos.”
lines.zh: 晚饭之后转场到 Ami 的卧室，我俩坐在她的小沙发上，她给我看{i}我{/i}觉得可以说是「多得恶心的猫片」。

lines.en: This goes on for almost one hour before I toss her phone across the room and drag her back out into the living room so we can watch a movie.
lines.zh: 这样持续了快一个小时，最后我把她的手机扔到房间另一头，拽着她回到客厅去看电影。

lines.en: Preferably one without cats.
scene black
I put on the first thing I find on Netflix and try to get myself absorbed in it, but fail spectacularly as whatever I chose in my anti-feline stupor is somehow even worse.
lines.zh: 我打开 Netflix 上随手找到的第一部，试着让自己沉浸进去，结果败得一塌糊涂——我在「反猫」的昏头状态下挑中的片子，不知怎的更糟。

lines.en: Of course, Ami seems to like whatever it is because that is just how my night is going to go, I guess.
lines.zh: 当然，Ami 好像还挺喜欢的——我看今晚大概就是这么个走向吧。

lines.en: Thankfully, she doesn’t mind me talking throughout the entire thing and the two of us discuss scattered topics like her work and how she’s starting to hate the heat a little less.
lines.zh: 所幸她不介意我从头说到尾，我俩东拉西扯地聊，聊她的工作，聊她开始不那么讨厌夏天的高温了。

lines.en: I have no idea {i}how{/i} given that this summer has been so hot that even our air conditioner is struggling to keep up with it, but I guess she’s free to like whatever she wants.
lines.zh: 我是不明白她{i}怎么{/i}办到的——今年夏天热得连空调都快扛不住了——不过她爱喜欢什么就喜欢什么吧。

lines.en: We fall asleep together on the couch and I wake up about an hour later to find that the TV has already turned off.
lines.zh: 我俩在沙发上一块儿睡着了，大约一个小时后我醒来，发现电视已经关了。

lines.en: Not wanting to carry her, I grab a blanket off of Ami’s bed and toss it over her before heading back to my room and allowing myself to fall asleep on something more comfortable.
lines.zh: 我不想把她抱起来，就从 Ami 床上抓了条毯子盖在她身上，然后回自己房间，在更舒服的地方睡去。
